title: More nations' record scorers
brief: Name each nation's all-time top scorer in full internationals.

notes.Denis Law: Denis Law shares Scotland's record with Kenny Dalglish on 30.
notes.Jon Dahl Tomasson: Jon Dahl Tomasson shares Denmark's record with Poul Nielsen on 52.
notes.Clint Dempsey: Clint Dempsey shares the USA record with Landon Donovan on 57.
notes.Ian Rush: Ian Rush (28) is second for Wales behind Bale.
notes.Kyle Lafferty: Kyle Lafferty (20) is second for Northern Ireland.
notes.Niall Quinn: Niall Quinn is second for Ireland, far behind Keane.
notes.Ivan Perisic: Ivan Perisic is second for Croatia behind Suker.
notes.Edinson Cavani: Edinson Cavani (58) is second for Uruguay behind Suarez.
notes.Sven Rydell: Sven Rydell (49) is second for Sweden.
notes.Wlodzimierz Lubanski: Wlodzimierz Lubanski is second for Poland.
notes.Ally McCoist: Ally McCoist (19) is not Scotland's record scorer; Dalglish and Law share it on 30.

checks: Each record holder agrees between the nation's Wikipedia infobox (August 2026 revision) and Transfermarkt's record scorers page. Shared records are one slot with both names. Denmark: Wikipedia and RSSSF both give Tomasson 52, level with Nielsen (Transfermarkt has 51, which would leave Nielsen alone, so either name counts). Wales: Bale has 41 in the FAW's count and Wikipedia (Transfermarkt 40); he is the record holder either way. Lewandowski counted to 19 July 2026 (89; he scored again in September and October).
